# Project Repository

<p class="hero-subtitle">This website is generated with Quarto and hosted on GitHub Pages. Project metadata live in <code>data/projects.csv</code>, while detailed content lives in Markdown files.</p>
:::
:::

::: {.site-main .normal-top}

## How to update this site

1. Edit `data/projects.csv` to update searchable metadata.
2. Edit project Markdown files inside `projects/projectXX/`.
3. Render the website:

```bash
quarto render
```

4. Commit and push:

```bash
git add .
git commit -m "Update project website"
git push
```

## Where content lives

| Content | File location |
|---|---|
| Search metadata | `data/projects.csv` |
| Project overview | `projects/projectXX/index.md` |
| Peers | `projects/projectXX/peers.md` |
| Papers | `projects/projectXX/papers.md` |
| Code | `projects/projectXX/code.md` |
| Videos | `projects/projectXX/videos.md` |

:::
